message: よきかな

name: Ria
message: 「Pom-pom♪ Namu-namu-namu...」

name: Synn
message: 「Clap-clap, mumble-mumble...」
Today, at Ria-senpai's invitation, I came to visit Asukai Shrine.

name: Ria
message: 「There, all done!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that Kirafes is safely over, next up is the Holy Night Festival, huh. Of course I'll do my absolute best, but--」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, it's totally fine to rely on a little divine help\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Just like that, make sure you rely on me and everyone else properly too, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... y-yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「You brought me all the way out here to teach me that, didn't you」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Guess you caught me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Having to ask to make sure shows you've still got a ways to go, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Even if you say that, seeing Ria-senpai at a shrine is pretty unusual, isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「You think so? Believe it or not, the Kujo family are parishioners of Asukai Shrine, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? B―But Ryuusei Academy is a mission school, right? Since the Kujo family has always served as board chair, I just assumed―」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem, the Kujo family's motto is literally anything goes!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uhaa~n, even an unprincipled Ria-chan like that is super cute」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, Shio-chan goes here too, so maybe it wasn't something to worry about...」

name: Sally
message: 「Heya Prez, heya Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sally―ch―」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, she flew right off toward the shrine office」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, she probably has plans to hang out with Shio-chan」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayane-chan and I used to play here all the time when we were kids too」

name: Ria
message: 「You can do way more things on shrine grounds than at a park or amusement park with actual playground equipment, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Plus, once a year, only in November, they hand out 'zenzai.' Keep it a secret from everyone else, okay\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「'Zenzai' is that sweet dish with red bean paste poured over mochi, right? W-We get that for free!? How extravagant!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, Synn, that's a little different.」
Shrine Office--

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chii, hell-o-wanko soba~」

name: Shio
message: 「I would like to return your greeting, however... Hold on, Lady Sally, is that not a hamaya in your hand?」

name: Sally
message: 「So this is called a hamaya? It was hanging on the wall at the beef bowl shop. Since it's a weapon, I gotta use it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, Shio-chii. I wanna try shooting the hamaya.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ho-ho, admirable, most admirable is that spirit!」

name: Shio
message: 「However, to shoot a hamaya, one requires a specialized bow. Do you happen to have one?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nope, the beef bowl shop didn't have a bow like that. If you've got one here, lend it to me, pleeease.」

name: Shio
message: 「A crying shame, they just sold out a moment ago.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft! If I can't shoot it, I'll go return the hamaya later.」

name: Shio
message: 「Mm, a commendable mindset indeed.」
Shrine Grounds--

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Look at Sally, she's getting brushed off the exact same way I was.」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Awawa, that was when I was little, okay!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seeing you walk right into that and get all flustered is pretty lovely too, Ria.」

name: Sally
message: 「Chief, bye-bye-boo, Ria, bye-bye-boo.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Sally, please wait.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! You found a bow, didn't you!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, that is not the case.」

name: Shio
message: 「At the Frost Month ritual, we serve zenzai to the worshippers. Please do come by on that day as well, Lady Sally.」

name: Sally
message: 「What's zenzai? Is it yummy?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, it's sweet and you can drink cup after cup of it\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「??? You drink it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn, Asukai Shrine's zenzai uses the western term; in short, it is what is called oshiruko in the east.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm? What's oshiruko? A girl covered in juice?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey! Sally, you can't say things like that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oshiruko is... Wait right there, I'll draw a picture so it's easy to understand!」
Ria-senpai picks up a dead twig and starts drawing a picture of oshiruko on the shrine grounds to explain it to Sally.

name: Ria
message: 「The red beans and mochi go like this...」
T-This is...

name: Synn
message: 「I-I had no idea Asukai Shrine held an event like that in November.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn. Shinto rituals do not consist solely of festivals lined with food stalls.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so that's why I didn't notice.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mumu? Mu? Mumun? Zenzai, oshiruko...」

name: Sally
message: 「It's too hard, my head's all jumbled up~. Why go out of your way to call it something else?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is kotodama--the spiritual power of words. When written in kanji, 'zenzai' becomes '善哉.'」

name: Shio
message: 「'善哉,' '善き哉,' 'yoki kana'--meaning 'how wonderful.'」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's what it meant. I'll have to tell Saiki too... scratch, scratch, scratch」
T-This is bad. On the sacred ground of the shrine precincts, something indescribable is...!

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, I'll leave the rest to ya, okay? *Thud*」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy?」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawawa, Ria... *shiver, tremble*」

name: Ria
message: 「All do~ne\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, might this drawing be of the ominous gods from outer space?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyooeeeeh, what is this? It's scary, it's scary, Boss, save meee!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally, where are you going?」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah!? I-I must attend to my duties at the shrine office, so please excuse me」
Shio-chan? Did she seriously just run away?

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, after I went through all the trouble of drawing it」
Nngh!? The words won't come out right. What in the world happened to me!?

name: Ria
message: 「Since we're here, I'll explain it to you, Synn\s07  There are two key points to this oshiruko」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... uh... ugh...」

name: Ria
message: 「You get it, don't you♪  Just as you say, Synn, how well the red beans have melted, and the char on the mochi--」
Oh, a bird...
